name: pixijs-jianghu
description: PixiJS web client for 江湖 OL — reuses JHOnlineData + mock-server protocol notes

scripts.prebuild: npm run sync:assets && npm run gen:scenes
scripts.cap:sync: npm run patch:cap-android8 && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:android: npm run build && npm run cap:sync && node scripts/assemble-android.mjs
scripts.smoke: node scripts/smoke-decode.mjs && tsx scripts/smoke-scene.ts && tsx scripts/smoke-protocol.ts && tsx scripts/smoke-actor.ts
